q: By what means did John know about the Word of life?
a: John had heard, seen, contemplated, and handled the Word of life.

q: Where was eternal life before it was manifested to John?
a: Eternal life was with the Father before it was manifested to John.

q: Why is John declaring what he has seen and heard?
a: John is declaring what he has seen and heard so that others may also have fellowship with him.

q: With whom does John already have fellowship?
a: John already has fellowship with the Father and his Son, Jesus Christ.

q: What is the message from God that John is announcing to his readers?
a: John is announcing the message that God is light, and in him there is no darkness at all.

q: What does John say about a person who says he has fellowship with God, but walks in darkness?
a: John says that such a person is a liar and does not practice the truth.

q: What cleanses all the sin of those walking in the light?
a: The blood of Jesus cleanses them from all sin.

q: What do we do to ourselves if we say we have no sin?
a: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us.

q: What will God do for those who confess their sins?
a: For those who confess their sins, God will forgive their sins and cleanse them from all unrighteousness.

q: For whom is Jesus Christ the propitiation for their sins?
a: Jesus Christ is the propitiation for the sins for the whole world.

q: How do we know that we have known Jesus Christ?
a: We know that we have known him if we keep his commandments.

q: What kind of person says he knows God, but does not keep God’s commandments?
a: A liar says he knows God, but does not keep God’s commandments.

q: How should a person walk if he says he remains in Christ?
a: He should walk even as Jesus Christ walked.

q: What is the spiritual condition of someone who says he is in the light, but hates his brother?
a: Someone who says he is in the light, but hates his brother, is in the darkness.

q: What is the spiritual condition of someone who hates his brother?
a: Someone who hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness.

q: Why does God forgive the sins of believers?
a: God forgives the sins of believers because of his name.

q: What should the attitude of a believer be toward the things of the world?
a: A believer must not love the world nor the things of the world.

q: What are three things that come from the world rather than from the Father?
a: The lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the vain glory of life are from the world, and not from the Father.

q: How do we know that it is the last hour?
a: We know it is the last hour because many antichrists have come.

q: Can someone deny the Son and yet have the Father?
a: No, someone who denies the Son cannot have the Father.

q: What must believers to do in order to remain in the Son and in the Father?
a: They must remain in what they have heard from the beginning.

q: What promise has been given the believers by God?
a: God has promised everlasting life to the believers.

q: What attitudes will we have when Christ appears if we remain in him?
a: If we remain in him, we will have boldness and will not be ashamed when Christ appears.

q: How has the Father expressed his love to believers?
a: He has made it possible for them to be called children of God.

q: What will happen to believers when Christ is revealed?
a: When Christ is revealed, believers will be like Christ because they will see him as he is.

q: What action concerning himself should be taken by every believer who hopes in Christ?
a: Every believer who hopes in Christ should purify himself.

q: What does Christ not have in himself?
a: Christ has no sin in himself.

q: If a person continues to sin, what does that tell us about their relationship to God?
a: It tells us they have neither seen Christ, nor known him.

q: For what reason was the Son of God revealed?
a: The Son of God was revealed in order to destroy the works of the devil.

q: Why is the one who is begotten from God not able to continue to sin?
a: He is not able to continue to sin because God’s seed remains in him.

q: What is the message that we have heard from the beginning?
a: The message is that we should love one another.

q: How did Cain demonstrate that he was from the evil one?
a: Cain demonstrated that he was from the evil one by murdering his brother.

q: What does John say should not amaze believers?
a: John says believers should not be amazed that the world hates them.

q: What attitude demonstrates that we have relocated from death to life?
a: We know we have relocated from death to life because we love the brothers.

q: How have we known love?
a: We have known love because Christ laid down his life for us.

q: What indicates that a person does not have the love of God in him?
a: When someone who is rich sees a brother in need, but does not help him, the love of God does not remain in that person.

q: What are two ways in which it is insufficient for us to love?
a: If is not enough for us to love only in word or tongue.

q: What are two ways in which we should love?
a: We should love in deed and in truth.

q: What do we have if our heart does not condemn us?
a: If our heart does not condemn us, we have confidence toward God.

q: What is the commandment that God has given to us?
a: God’s commandment is that we should believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ and love one another.

q: How do believers know that God remains in them?
a: God has given believers the Spirit so that they know God remains in them.

q: Why should believers not believe every spirit?
a: They should not believe every spirit because there are many false prophets that have gone out into the world.

q: How can you know the Spirit of God?
a: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God.

q: How are believers able to overcome spirits that are not from God?
a: We can overcome them because the spirit in us is greater than the one in the world.

q: Why should believers love one another?
a: Believers should love one another because love is from God, and the one who is begotten from God loves.

q: How does the one who does not love demonstrate that he does not know God?
a: People who know God love because God is love.

q: How did God reveal his love for us?
a: God revealed his love for us by sending his only begotten Son into the world.

q: For what purpose did the Father send his Son?
a: The Father sent his Son so that we might live through him.

q: If God remains in a person and he remains in God, what does that person confess about Jesus?
a: The person who remains in God confess that Jesus is the Son of God.

q: What attitude will the love of God cause us to have on the day of judgment?
a: The love of God will cause us to have confidence on the day of judgment.

q: How are we able to love?
a: We love because God first loved us.

q: If someone hates his brother, what relationship does he have with God?
a: Someone who hates his brother is not able to love God.

q: How should the one who loves God treat his brother?
a: The one who loves God should also love his brother.

q: How do we demonstrate that we love God?
a: We demonstrate that we love God when we keep his commandments.

q: By what two things did Jesus Christ come?
a: Jesus Christ came by water and by blood.

q: What three things testify about Jesus Christ?
a: The Spirit, the water, and the blood all testify about Jesus Christ.

q: If someone does not believe the testimony of God concerning his Son, what do they make God to be?
a: Anyone who does not believe the testimony of God concerning his Son makes God to be a liar.

q: What has God given us in his Son?
a: God has given us everlasting life in his Son.

q: What confidence do believers have before God?
a: Believers have confidence that if they ask anything according to God’s will, he hears them.

q: What should a believer do when he sees his brother committing a sin not to death?
a: A believer who sees his brother committing a sin not to death should pray that God will give his brother life.

q: What is all unrighteousness?
a: All unrighteousness is sin.

q: Where does the whole world lie?
a: The whole world lies in the evil one.

q: What is the result of the understanding that the Son of God has given to us?
a: Because of the understanding that the Son of God has given to us, we may know the True One.

q: From what must believers keep themselves?
a: Believers must keep themselves from idols.
